models.title: Forward-implied expected future spot rate under speculative efficiency
models.summary: The owner introduces the equality conditionally when forward rates are interpreted as expected future spot rates.

relationship.original_equation: Expected future spot rate = current forward rate
relationship.translation_notes: Forward and output have the same price-currency-per-base-currency unit; the sample currency pair is a concrete unit profile.

variables.context: Same price currency, base currency, quotation convention, valuation time and forward settlement date
Same price currency, base currency, quotation convention, valuation time and forward settlement date

assumptions: Speculative efficiency holds in this quote and the relevant horizon, including no exchange-risk premium or other forward-expectation wedge.
The forward and expected spot use the same price/base quotation and settlement date.
limitations: This conditional model is not a no-arbitrage identity or a guaranteed forecast; the BIS survey reports empirical rejection of unbiasedness.
The expected inverse exchange rate is generally not the inverse of the expected rate, so preserve quotation direction under uncertainty.
